description.p: Ryzora is a standalone native Linux desktop customization marketplace and configuration manager. It enables users to safely discover, preview, install, manage, and roll back complete desktop rices, status bars (Waybar), terminal configs, wallpapers, icon packs, and system themes.

Engineered with a strict zero-root, declarative packaging model, Ryzora enforces deterministic user-space directory confinement, cryptographic signature verification (Ed25519), and pre-install atomic snapshots for instant, byte-for-byte rollback.
Initial production-ready release featuring unified content providers, declarative package management, multi-tier Ed25519 cryptographic trust verification, and atomic snapshot rollbacks.
